note: Eight isolated native K3s fixtures cover CLI/Helm, both scopes and architectures, actual published predecessor upgrades, interruptions, rollback and complete retained OCI graph readback. Four actual Argo CD cases cover a separate future-version conformance build, interruption/recovery, sync, retention and both uninstall acknowledgment and active-provisioner safeguards. The conformance version is not a public release. Components use a fixture TLS mirror with unchanged official index digests; per-case catalog hashes describe that mirror. The chart is packaged from the official source with official pins; fixture mirror overrides are applied at installation. Real mixed-cluster deployment and public artifact verification are recorded separately.
